question: A person sold 25 articles for Rs. 2500 and incurred a loss of 10%. How many articles should he sell for Rs. 2400 to make a profit of 20%?
question_hi: एक व्यक्ति ने 25 वस्तुओं को 2500 रुपये में बेचा और उसे 10% का नुकसान हुआ। 20% लाभ कमाने के लिए उसे कितनी वस्तुएँ 2400 रुपये में बेचनी चाहिए?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

Use the direct relation: (Total Price1 / (Quantity1 × (100 − Loss%))) = (Total Price2 / (Quantity2 × (100 + Profit%)))

⇒ 2500 / (25 × 90) = 2400 / (n × 120)

⇒ 100 / 90 = 20 / n

⇒ 10 / 9 = 20 / n

⇒ n = (20 × 9) / 10 = 18

∴ The correct answer is 18.

Alternate Method

Given:

Quantity1 = 25 articles, Total SP1 = ₹2500, Loss = 10%

Desired Profit = 20%, Total SP2 = ₹2400

Formula: Cost Price (CP) = (100 × SP) / (100 ± P/L%)

⇒ Selling Price (SP) of 1 article = 2500 ÷ 25 = ₹100

⇒ Since loss is 10%, 90% of CP = ₹100

⇒ CP of 1 article = 100 ÷ 0.9 = ₹1000/9

⇒ New SP required for 20% profit = 120% of CP

⇒ New SP = (120/100) × (1000/9) = ₹400/3

⇒ Number of articles for ₹2400 = Total SP ÷ New SP per article

⇒ Number of articles = 2400 ÷ (400/3) = (2400 × 3) ÷ 400 = 6 × 3 = 18

∴ The correct answer is 18.

Additional Information

Cost Price and Selling Price Relationship

Cost Price (CP) is always considered 100%. If there is a profit of P%, SP = (100 + P)% of CP. If there is a loss of L%, SP = (100 − L)% of CP.

Unitary Method in Profit and Loss

When the number of articles changes, it is easiest to find the CP or SP of one single unit before calculating the total for the new quantity.

Profit/Loss Percentage

Profit or Loss percentage is always calculated on the Cost Price unless stated otherwise in the question. Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100.

⇒ चूंकि हानि 10% है, CP का 90% = ₹100

⇒ ₹2400 के लिए वस्तुओं की संख्या = कुल SP ÷ प्रति वस्तु नया SP

⇒ वस्तुओं की संख्या = 2400 ÷ (400/3) = (2400 × 3) ÷ 400 = 6 × 3 = 18

Additional Information

लागत मूल्य और विक्रय मूल्य संबंध

लागत मूल्य (CP) को हमेशा 100% माना जाता है। यदि P% का लाभ होता है, तो SP = CP का (100 + P)%। यदि L% की हानि होती है, तो SP = CP का (100 − L)%।

लाभ और हानि में ऐकिक नियम (Unitary Method)

जब वस्तुओं की संख्या बदलती है, तो नई मात्रा के लिए कुल गणना करने से पहले एक एकल इकाई का CP या SP ज्ञात करना सबसे आसान होता है।

जब तक प्रश्न में अन्यथा न कहा गया हो, लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत की गणना हमेशा लागत मूल्य पर की जाती है। लाभ % = (लाभ/CP) × 100.

question: The average production of all type of cars in 2014 is approximately what percent less than the production of type B cars in 2013 and type D cars in 2010 taken together?
question_hi: 2014 में सभी प्रकार की कारों का औसत उत्पादन 2013 में B प्रकार की कारों और 2010 में D प्रकार की कारों के संयुक्त उत्पादन से कितना प्रतिशत कम है?
solution:
Total production of cars in 2014 = 63 + 64 + 56 + 65 + 72 = 320 thousands

Average production of cars in 2014 = 320/5 = 64 thousands

Total production of type B cars in 2013 and type D cars in 2010 = 68 + 42 = 110

∴ Required percentage = [(110 – 64)/110] × 100 = 41.81%

question: If the 10-digit number 897359y7x2 is divisible by 72, then what is the value of (3x – y), for the possible maximum value of x and y?
question_hi: यदि 10-अंकीय संख्या 897359y7x2 72 से विभाज्य है, तो x और y के अधिकतम अधिकतम मान के लिए (3x - y) का मान क्या है?
solution:
Divisibility rule of 9: A number divisible by 9 if the sum of its digit is divisible by 9.

Divisibility rule of 8: A number divisible by 8 if the last three digit of the number is divisible by 8

⇒ 7x2 is divisible by 8 if x = 9

⇒ 897359y792 is divisible by 9 if y = 4

⇒ 3x – y

⇒ 3 × 9 – 4

⇒ 27 – 4

⇒ 23

question: The total number of students in section A and B of a class is 110. The number of students in section A is 10 more than that of section B. The average score of the student in B, in a test, is 20% more than that of students in A. If the average score of all students in the class is 72, then what is the average score of the students in A?
question_hi: एक कक्षा के सेक्शन A और B में कुल छात्रों की संख्या 110 है। सेक्शन A में छात्रों की संख्या सेक्शन B की तुलना में 10 अधिक है। एक परीक्षा में, B के छात्रों का औसत स्कोर A के छात्रों की तुलना में 20% अधिक है। यदि कक्षा में सभी छात्रों का औसत स्कोर 72 है, तो A के छात्रों का औसत स्कोर क्या है?
solution:
Let the number of students in section B be x number of students in section A = x + 10

According to the question

⇒ x + 10 + x = 110

⇒ x = 50

Number of students in section A = 60

Number of students in section B = 50

Sum of score of all students = 110 × 72 = 7920

Let the average score of students in section A be x.

Average score of students in section B = x × [120/100] = 1.2x

According to the question

60x + 50 × 1.2x = 7920

⇒ 60x + 60x = 7920

⇒ x = 7920/120 = 66

∴ Average score of students of section A = 66
solution_hi:
माना कि सेक्शन B में छात्रों की संख्या x है तो सेक्शन A में छात्रों की संख्या = x + 10

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

⇒ x + 10 + x = 110

⇒ x = 50

सेक्शन A में छात्रों की संख्या = 60

सेक्शन B में छात्रों की संख्या = 50

सभी छात्रों के स्कोर का योग = 110 × 72 = 7920

माना कि सेक्शन A के छात्रों का औसत स्कोर x है।

सेक्शन B के छात्रों का औसत स्कोर = x × [120/100] = 1.2x

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

60x + 50 × 1.2x = 7920

⇒ 60x + 60x = 7920

⇒ x = 7920/120 = 66

∴ सेक्शन A के छात्रों का औसत स्कोर = 66

question: A is 20% less than B while C is 20% more than D. If D is 25% less than A which of the following is true :
question_hi: A B से 20% कम है जबकि C D से 20% अधिक है। यदि D A से 25% कम है तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सत्या है?

We can write, 20% = 1/5, 25% = 1/4

Ratio of A to B = 4 : 5      ---- 1

Ratio of C to D = 6 : 5     ---- 2

Ratio of A to D = 4 : 3     ---- 3

Multiply equation (1) and equation (3) by 5 and multiply equation (2) by 3

Ratio of A : B : C : D = 20 : 25 : 18 : 15

⇒ C : B = 18 : 25

⇒ C = 18/25 B

⇒ C = 0.72B
solution_hi:

question: The area of a field in the shape of a triangle with each side x meters is equal to the area another triangular field having sides 50 m. 70 m and 80 m. The value of x is closed to:
question_hi: x मीटर की प्रत्येक भुजाओं वाले त्रिभुज के आकार के एक क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल 50 मीटर, 70 मीटर और 80 मीटर वाली भुजाओं वाले एक अन्य त्रिभुज क्षेत्र के क्षेत्रफल के समान है। x का मान सबसे नज़दीक किसके होगा?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

Area of triangle with sides 50, 70, 80: s = 100, Area = √(100 × 50 × 30 × 20) = 1000√3 m2.

Equilateral triangle area = (√3/4) × x2.

Equating both: (√3/4) × x2 = 1000√3 ⇒ x2 = 4000.

x = √4000 ≈ 63.24 m.

∴ The correct answer is 63.2 m.

Alternate Method

Given: Sides of the second triangular field are 50 m, 70 m, and 80 m. The first field is an equilateral triangle with side x.

Formula Used: Heron's formula Area = √(s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)) and Equilateral Area = (√3/4)x2.

⇒ Semi-perimeter (s) = (50 + 70 + 80) / 2 = 100 m

⇒ Area of second field = √(100 × (100−50) × (100−70) × (100−80))

⇒ Area = √(100 × 50 × 30 × 20) = √(3,000,000) = 1000√3 m2

⇒ Area of first field = (√3 / 4) × x2 = 1000√3

⇒ x2 = 4000

⇒ x = √4000 = 20√10 ≈ 20 × 3.162 = 63.24 m

∴ The correct answer is 63.2 m.

Additional Information

Heron's Formula

Used for scalene triangles where sides a, b, c are known: Area = √(s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)) where s = (a+b+c)/2.

Equilateral Triangle Properties

For side x, Area = (√3/4)x2 and Height = (√3/2)x.

Square Root Approximations

Since 602 = 3600 and 702 = 4900, √4000 must lie between 60 and 70, specifically closer to 63 (632 = 3969).

50, 70, 80 भुजाओं वाले त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल: s = 100, क्षेत्रफल = √(100 × 50 × 30 × 20) = 1000√3 m2.

समबाहु त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल = (√3/4) × x2.

दोनों की तुलना करने पर: (√3/4) × x2 = 1000√3 ⇒ x2 = 4000.

⇒ दूसरे मैदान का क्षेत्रफल = √(100 × (100−50) × (100−70) × (100−80))

⇒ पहले मैदान का क्षेत्रफल = (√3 / 4) × x2 = 1000√3

⇒ x2 = 4000

⇒ x = √4000 = 20√10 ≈ 20 × 3.162 = 63.24 m

∴ सही उत्तर 63.2 m है।

question: In a circle of radius 10 cm and centre O, PQ and PR are two equal chords, each of length 12 cm. What is the length of chord QR?
question_hi: 10 सेंटीमीटर त्रिज्या और O केंद्र वाले वृत्त में, PQ और PR दो समान जीवा हैं, जिनकी प्रत्येक लंबाई 12 सेंटीमीटर है। जीवा QR की लंबाई क्या है?
solution:
Given, PQ = PR = 12 cm and OR = OQ = OP = 10 cm

Suppose SQ = RS = x cm and OS = y cm

PS = (10 – y)

In ΔPRS,

RP2 = PS2 + RS2 [Using Pythagoras theorem]

122 = (10 – y)2 + x2

⇒ 144 = 102 + y2 – 2 × 10 × y + x2

⇒ 144 = 100 + y2 – 20y + x2       ----(1)

In ΔRSO,

OR2 = RS2 + OS2 [Using Pythagoras theorem]

⇒ 102 = x2 + y2

⇒ 100 = x2 + y2      ----(2)

Subtract equation (2) from equation (1)

144 – 100 = 100 + y2 – 20y + x2 – x2 – y2

⇒ 20y = 56

⇒ y = 14/5

From equation (2)

100 = x2 + (14/5)2

⇒ x2 = 100 – [196/25]

⇒ x2 = (2500 – 196)/25 = 2304/25

⇒ x = 48/5

⇒ 2x = 2 × [48/5] = 96/5 = 19.2 cm

∴ RQ = 2x = 19.2 cm

question: A Person can row a distance of 4 km upstream in 1 hour 20 minutes and can row back to the starting point in just 24 minutes. How much time (in hours) will he take to row 13 km in still water?
question_hi: एक व्यक्ति ऊपरी धारा में 4 किमी की दूरी तक 1 घंटा 20 मिनट में नाव चलाकर पहुँच सकता है और वापस शुरुआती स्थान पर केवल 24 मिनट में नाव चलाकर पहुँच सकता है। ठहरे हुए पानी में उस व्यक्ति को 13 किमी वापस नाव चलाकर पहुँचने में कितना समय (घंटों में) लगेगा?
solution:
Given:

Time taken to cover a distance of 4 km upstream = 1 hour 20 minutes = 4/3 hours

Time taken to cover a distance of 4 km downstream = 24 minutes

Concept Used:

The direction along the stream is called downstream.

The direction against the stream is called upstream.

Formula Used:

Distance = Speed × Times

Downstream speed of the boat = Speed of boat + Speed of stream

⇒ Ds = x + y

Upstream speed of the boat = Speed of boat - Speed of stream

⇒ Us = x - y

Calculation:

Let Speed of boat in still water be x km/hr & speed of stream be y km/hr

According to the question,

⇒ 4/(x – y) = 4/3

⇒ x – y = 3      ----(1)

⇒ 4/(x + y) = 24/60

⇒ x + y = 10     ----(2)

Add equation (1) and equation (2) we get,

⇒ 2x = 13

⇒ x = 13/2 km/hr

Time taken to row 13 km in still water = Distance covered/Speed of boat

Time taken = 13 ÷ 13/2 = 2 hrs

question: To do a certain work, A and B work on alternate days, with B beginning the work on the first day. A can finish the work alone in 48 days. If the work gets completed in \(11\frac{1}{3}\) days, then B alone can finish 4 times the same work in:
question_hi: एक निश्चित कार्य को करने के लिए, A और B एकांतर दिनों में कार्य करते हैं, जहाँ B पहले दिन कार्य शुरू करता है। A अकेले उस कार्य को 48 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। यदि कार्य \(11\frac{1}{3}\) दिनों में पूरा हो जाता है, तो B अकेले उसी कार्य के 4 गुने को कितने समय में पूरा कर सकता है?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

Total time = 11(1/3) days (B starts first). B works on days 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 (6 days); A works on days 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 1/3 of day 12 (5 + 1/3 = 16/3 days).

Work done by A = (16/3) ÷ 48 = 1/9. Remaining work done by B = 1 − 1/9 = 8/9.

B finishes 8/9 work in 6 days ⇒ B finishes full work in (6 × 9)/8 = 27/4 days.

B finishes 4 times the work in (27/4) × 4 = 27 days.

∴ The correct answer is 27 days.

Alternate Method

Given: A alone = 48 days. Total alternate time = 11(1/3) days. B starts on day 1.

Distribution of work days:

⇒ B works on days: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 → Total 6 days.

⇒ A works on days: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, and 1/3 of the 12th day → Total 5 + 1/3 = 16/3 days.

⇒ Work done by A in 16/3 days = (16/3) × (1/48) = 1/9 of total work.

⇒ Work done by B in 6 days = 1 − 1/9 = 8/9 of total work.

⇒ Time taken by B to finish 1 complete work = 6 ÷ (8/9) = (6 × 9) / 8 = 27/4 days.

⇒ Time taken by B to finish 4 times the same work = 4 × (27/4) = 27 days.

∴ The correct answer is 27 days.

Additional Information

Alternate Day Work

In alternate work, identify who starts first. If total time is T, and B starts, B works for ceil(T/2) days if T is not an even integer and cycle is 2 days.

Efficiency and Time

Time is inversely proportional to Efficiency. Work = Efficiency × Time. For multiple works, New Time = Original Time × Multiplier.
